name: Kamigori (Japan)
description: A light blue field charged at the centre with the Kamigori town emblem in white: a stylised angular device of a ring and swept strokes, like a bird.
history: Municipal flag of Kamigori, a town in Hyōgo Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 25 December 1958.

features.role: Kamigori town emblem — a stylised angular device of a ring and swept strokes, like a bird
